output.title: Route53 DNS01 fix: no issuer or solver configuration supplied
output.content: The fix only concerns how cert-manager detects AWS Route53 not-found errors when it deletes DNS records. It matters only if an issuer uses a Route53 DNS01 solver. The environment summary shows a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifest but no Issuer or ClusterIssuer manifests. The CRDs dimension is marked absent and the values are partial, so Route53 use can't be confirmed or ruled out. To check, look at your Issuer and ClusterIssuer resources for a Route53 DNS01 solver; if you find one, this fix applies to how DNS records are cleaned up.
